summary: Not a pass: 1 major, 5 minor. Every gate passed when I ran it: run_all printed `[tests] PASS`. All 17 game/tests/t_*.gd printed PASS, including `[t_ui] PASS` and `[t_uiicons] PASS ids=168 files=113 glyphs=54 code_ids=39 hook_ids=45 weight=0.61..1.47 worst_iou=0.80 ...`; t_save's 5 SCRIPT ERRORs are its deliberate aborts. smoke --no-import printed `SMOKE PASS`. ui_real_capture_lab printed `[uireal] PASS screens=hud,craft,skills,...` at 844x390 glc, 667x375 glc (the window came out 668x376), 1600x900 glc and 1600x900 Forward+. merge-tree against claude/mmo-overhaul is clean (tree 5f30a95b). Blind A/B: the new build won all 6 pairs (combat, hud and pet_out at 844x390 and 1600x900 glc). The old build has colour emoji on the combat rail (green T-rex SIC, orange runner CHASE, explosion TACKLE, yellow leg KICK), a thin small MENU, a talon for ANIMALS, letter chips B/K/G on plates and a captionless 'Auto' word. The new rail is one consistent white set, ANIMALS reads as a dinosaur head, AUTO has a caption and every caption is kept. The plan register has no W1-UIICONS section; I reviewed against HANDOFF.md row W1-UIICONS and the brief. The major: the HUD's own status chips under the target bar (and the player's) still draw two-letter codes (KN GR BL), although white icons exist for those ids. On the phone they are the only status display, because the plate chips do not show at 844x390.

findings.problem: The status chips still draw `str(inst.id).left(2).to_upper()`, which gives 'KN', 'GR', 'BL' in orange letters on a 26 px square. They sit right under the target health bar in every combat shot (combat_844x390, combat_668x376, combat_1600x900 in glc and Forward+). knockdown, groggy and bleed all have white icons in ui_icons.json. The creature plates were wired to those icons, but on the landscape phone the plates show no chips (plate_844x390, plate_front_844x390), so the two-letter codes are the only status read there. The package exists to replace old glyphs with the icon set, and this is the most visible status display.
findings.fix: In both loops, when `UiIcons.path_for(inst.id) != ""`, draw `UiIcons.icon(inst.id)` with draw_texture_rect into the 26 px box (inset 3 px, white, alpha la/a), and keep the letters only as the fallback. The CanvasItem already filters with mipmaps if you set texture_filter on the HUD, or draw from a mipmapped texture. Re-run ui_real_capture_lab at 844x390 and look at the combat shot.

findings.where: game/assets/icons/ui statuses drawn by status_glyph.gd on creature plates (combat_1600x900 glc and Forward+)
findings.problem: At 1600x900 the plate chip draws the white icon at about 10 px inside its 26 px coloured ring. The bleed drop reads, but the knockdown chevrons-over-line and the groggy spiral are at the edge of legibility (z/plateB.png, 5x zoom).
findings.fix: Draw the icon at about 70 % of the chip (18 px) and thin the ring to 2 px, or drop the ring and tint the chip fill instead.

findings.problem: The fix that moves the stance label clear of AUTO's caption leaves 'Attack Stance' floating about 40 px left of KICK on the bottom edge, unattached to the cluster (combat_1600x900). Durango anchors it beside the stance dial, under Auto.
findings.fix: Put it under AUTO's caption (cy + hex + CAPTION_H + 4), or right-align it to the cluster's right edge on the bottom row, so it reads as part of the cluster.

findings.problem: `"👁 %d"` (colour eye emoji) and `"◎ %d"` are still drawn with draw_string when no band is available, the path that is not the banner. t_uiicons counts 👁 as mapped (to xp), but it is not a HexButton glyph, so the mapping never applies and a colour emoji can still reach the HUD.
findings.fix: Draw the xp and t_stones icons with draw_texture_rect before the number, or use words ('XP 12', 'T-stones 3'). Have t_uiicons treat a mapped glyph inside a draw_string or Label literal as a failure.

findings.where: game/assets/icons/ui/claim.svg (hud, pet_out, radial at every size)
findings.problem: CLAIM is now a horned skull on a stake over two stones. At 24-30 px it reads as a cattle skull, a danger or death sign, more than a territory claim. The old grid read as a plot. The caption saves it, but it is the one context hex that misreads at phone size.
findings.fix: Draw a stake driven into ground with a pennant or hide flag, or a stake at the corner of a dashed plot outline.

findings.where: game/data/ui_icons.json "glyphs" with the hex_button.gd glyph setter
findings.problem: The setter now swaps any HexButton whose glyph is a mapped symbol for that icon, everywhere. Generic symbols are mapped to specific meanings: '−' to zoom_out, '●' to meadow, '▲' to rocky, '≈' to river, '✓' to confirm. A future hex that uses '−' for 'remove one' or '▲' for 'up' will silently draw a zoom lens or a mountain. No current call site does this; I grepped every `.glyph =` and `_hex(` site.
findings.fix: Limit the glyph table to the emoji and pictographs that have one meaning. Map the geometric symbols by id at their call sites (world_ui biome legend, map zoom).
